notes: Operator-maintained ticker→CIK map for the SEC adapter. The CIK is the identity key used in the request URL and is re-checked against the response. expected_entity_name_contains is an additional normalized containment check on the response entityName; a mismatch is a hard failure, not a warning. Extend this file to collect further US issuers; no code change is required. 2330.TW maps to Taiwan Semiconductor Manufacturing (CIK 0001046179), the SEC filer (Form 20-F/6-K) and issuer of the TWSE 2330 common shares; its 6-K headers state "TWSE: 2330, NYSE: TSM". The row is used only to bind archive document URLs to that issuer; the latest-financials check for TWSE/TPEx tickers follows the Taiwan statutory deadline, not the SEC 10-Q/10-K index. The 2330.TW name check is "TSMC" because TSMC exhibits (e.g. earnings releases) name the issuer only as "TSMC (TWSE: 2330, NYSE: TSM)"; the archive-path CIK remains the identity key. fiscal_year_end_month is the month in which the fiscal year ends (52/53-week years end near that month); it only names fiscal periods and never shifts a reported window. edgar_conformed_name_contains (optional) is the containment check applied to the EDGAR conformed company name in the submissions index and accession headers used by the filing catalog; it defaults to expected_entity_name_contains. For 2330.TW the EDGAR conformed name differs from the exhibit short name, so it is configured explicitly; the CIK stays the identity key and a mismatch still fails closed.
